in_marathi.name: पंकज
in_marathi.long_meaning: पंकज हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'panchaja' meaning 'fifth'. In Hindu mythology, the god Krishna is also called 'Pankaj' as he is the fifth avatar of Lord Vishnu. The name symbolizes the divine and the precious.

In Hindu mythology, the god Krishna is also called 'Pankaj' as he is the fifth avatar of Lord Vishnu. The name symbolizes the divine and the precious.
